ResearchProjectDef.label: labor fungi
ResearchProjectDef.description: Grow toilcap, greencap and packcap, and bundle them into worker packages.

ResearchProjectDef.label: refined labor fungi
ResearchProjectDef.description: Steep toilcap, greencap and packcap in shroom broth to remove their downsides, in single caps or refined worker packages.

ResearchProjectDef.label: deeper forbidden fungi
ResearchProjectDef.description: Grow gorecap, martyrcap and vigilcap: three more extreme mushrooms with brutal downsides. Requires forbidden fungi.

ResearchProjectDef.label: refined deeper forbidden fungi
ResearchProjectDef.description: Steep gorecap, martyrcap and vigilcap in shroom broth. Their downsides are gone, but so is some of the raw power.
